note: Source register. source_tier records how the text was obtained, which is what the confidence model keys on. A rule must reference at least one source_id here.

sources.title: Central Insurance of Iran - بیمه‌های خودرو (motor insurance compilation: regulations, statute and circulars)
used_for: Regulation 53 general conditions
Circular 1400/401/146850 salvage/franchise ordering
Compulsory Third-Party Insurance Law 1395 (Article 8) as reproduced
sources.access_note: Compilation document; authoritative accessible copy used for statute-level cross-checking.

sources.title: Iran Insurance - آیین نامه شماره 53
sources.access_note: Direct open timed out during research; clause-level checks used the Central Insurance compilation and the mirror below.
used_for: Regulation 53 approval date and clause structure

sources.title: Complete text of Regulation 53 (mirror host)
used_for: Regulation 53 Articles 3-6 (perils, endorsable exclusions, non-compensable circumstances)
Regulation 53 Articles 10-14 (rescue ceiling, duties, subrogation)
Regulation 53 Articles 19-21 (partial/total loss, depreciation, underinsurance, multiple insurance)
sources.access_note: Text mirror used to inspect clause wording; not elevated above the Central Insurance compilation.

sources.title: High Insurance Council instruction - Article 8 corresponding damage
used_for: Conventional vehicle definition: market value < 50% of annual bodily ceiling
Non-conventional vehicle definition: >= 50%
Component-wise corresponding damage to the most expensive conventional car
Same-part / similar-part rules and highest qualifying part value rule

sources.title: Central Insurance circular - non-conventional vehicles and the victim's own body insurance
used_for: Article 8 non-corresponding excess may be paid by the victim's own body policy
No regulatory mandate to treat that body payment as a claims-history event or to deduct a franchise
Any such insurer treatment must be disclosed at issuance; ambiguity favours the insured (Regulation 71)

sources.title: Central Insurance circular 1400/401/146850 - total-loss salvage and franchise ordering
used_for: Salvage is not itself damage
Total-loss franchise is calculated after probable salvage is deducted

sources.title: Compulsory Third-Party Insurance Law 1395
used_for: Minimum bodily and financial commitments
Financial commitment = 2.5% of bodily commitment
Non-conventional vehicle limitation on financial compensation
Statutory recourse against the at-fault party
sources.access_note: Accessed as Statute Article 8 reproduced inside the Central Insurance motor-insurance compilation.

sources.title: Iran Insurance public claims FAQ - آنالیز خسارت پرداختی چگونه است؟
used_for: Evidence that body franchise rates are insurer-specific (illustration only, never a statutory schedule)
sources.access_note: Page timed out when opened; indexed content only. Must not be elevated above actual policy wording.

sources.title: Bimeh.com - 1405 diyah table
used_for: Reports 1405 sacred-month full diyah at 2.8 billion tomans
Basis for the derived 1.4bn-toman conventional threshold and 70m-toman minimum financial commitment
sources.access_note: Secondary source. The 50% and 2.5% derivation rules are primary law; the 1405 diyah base is not yet primary-verified.

sources.title: Insurer claims manuals and franchise schedules (Asia, Pasargad, Parsian and others)
sources.access_note: No sufficiently detailed current authoritative public manual was retrieved. The insurer adapter layer is deliberately unpopulated; see uncertainties U02, U03, U06.

sources.title: Iran Insurance - شرایط عمومی بیمه بدنه اتومبیل (Regulation 53 as published by the insurer)
sources.authority: High Insurance Council (شورای عالی بیمه), published by Iran Insurance Co.
sources.instrument: Regulation 53 - general conditions of land vehicle body insurance
used_for: Article numbering of the notice, mitigation, no-unauthorised-repair and subrogation duties
Confirming the twenty per cent rescue ceiling and the five-working-day notice from awareness
Confirming that the regulation names no expert board and no per-peril document list
sources.access_note: Insurer-hosted copy, opened and read. Still not an official-gazette or Central Insurance copy, so it corroborates numbering but does not upgrade the source tier above PRIMARY_MIRROR.

sources.title: Iran Insurance - شرایط خصوصی و پوشش‌های الحاقی بیمه بدنه (glass, parts theft, loss of use, price-fluctuation wordings)
sources.instrument: Private conditions and additional coverages of the body policy
used_for: Standalone glass: current glass value plus installation, stated franchise, and the condition that the vehicle be insured at market value

Parts theft: ceiling at the lesser of insured or current accessory value, fifty per cent of new for tyres, battery and spare wheel, twenty per cent franchise, insurer right to withdraw the cover after a claim
Loss of use: capped daily indemnity with a three-day franchise, and the price-fluctuation increase cover
sources.access_note: One company's wording. It is evidence for what an endorsement schedule can contain and for the fields the questionnaire must read; it is not authority for other insurers or products. See U03, U11, U14.

sources.title: Iran Insurance - حق بیمه و فرانشیز بیمه بدنه (published franchise schedule)
used_for: Shows that franchise rates, first-versus-later claim counts, driver age and licence-history surcharges, and a not-at-fault reduction are insurer terms
Shows that theft, partial theft and total loss carry their own lines within one schedule
sources.access_note: No printed version or effective date on the page, and some minimum amounts look legacy. Recorded as a calibration candidate for U02; the engine must not execute any of these rates until a dated instrument is ingested.

sources.title: Bimeh Day - مدارک و مراحل پرداخت خسارت بیمه بدنه
sources.instrument: Published claims documents and procedure page
used_for: Per-peril document lists used in practice: croquis and authority reports, fire cause report, police station and criminal investigation files, non-discovery enquiry, ownership and technical-inspection papers
One insurer's statement of the sixty-day theft settlement clock
sources.access_note: A company checklist, not regulation. It supplies the evidence vocabulary of the questionnaire; it cannot supply a formula. See U13.

sources.title: Regulation 53 full text (practitioner mirror)
used_for: Independent corroboration of article numbering against the other two copies
sources.access_note: Unofficial host. Corroboration only; never the sole authority for an amount-affecting rule.

sources.title: دستورالعمل نحوه محاسبه خسارت کسر قیمت وسیله نقلیه (High Insurance Council instruction)
used_for: Evidence that third-party diminution of value is governed by its own current instruction, not by the body policy's exclusion
Formula shape: age coefficient times accident coefficient times vehicle value over four hundred, capped at twenty per cent of value and excluded above seventy per cent repair cost
sources.access_note: Single unofficial mirror; the header dates were not cross-checked against an official copy. Relevant to U09, which is a third-party matter and outside the body branches.
